install_startup.recipe_modification_note: No Dockerfile or compose file shipped with this project - it's a pure Go server (an SFU video-conferencing server), meant to be built with `go build` and run directly per its own README. Wrote a multi-stage Dockerfile matching that exactly: golang:1.24-bookworm builder runs the project's own documented `CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags='-s -w'`, final stage is a plain debian-slim with just the resulting static binary + static/ assets, a groups/ config with one operator user created the same way the README's own quickstart does (createuser/password directly in a JSON file, no external auth). Serves HTTPS with a self-signed cert by default (the project's own behavior, not a workaround) - screens.py already sets ignore_https_errors, so this needed no crawler changes.
